about.title: About Agent Atlas
about.body:
Agent Atlas is an educational project that helps to understand how AI agents work, communicate and are orchestrated.

## Educational use only

Agent Atlas is a learning tool. It is not meant for real work.

## Licences

- The code is open source under the MIT licence.
- The site text, articles and translations are under CC BY 4.0.
- The name and logo of Agent Atlas are not licensed for reuse.

## Source code

The code is open at [github.com/cimenta/agent-atlas-academy](https://github.com/cimenta/agent-atlas-academy).

## Bugs and ideas

Found a bug or have an idea? See [Bugs and ideas in Help](#/help/bugs).

## Legal

Read the [privacy policy](#/page/privacy), the [terms of use](#/page/terms) and the [imprint](#/page/imprint).

harness.title: Harness
harness.intro: The harness is everything around the model: the loop of agents, the limits, the time cap, retries and the rules for keys. The pages Limits, Retries, Fallback model, Cost, Guards and Tools hold what you can set, and Fixed harness the rules that always apply. Press ? next to a setting to read what it does.
harness.fallbackNote: The model it falls back to is fixed: Fast is replaced by Balanced, Balanced by Fast and Strong by Balanced, always within the same provider and key. A free Gemini key is never moved to a model that needs a paid key.
harness.fallbackIntro: What happens when an agent still fails after all its tries.
harness.fallback.offHint: The run stops. You can use Retry yourself.
harness.fallback.suggestHint: The run stops, and the Retry menu marks the model it suggests.
harness.fallback.autoHint: One more try with another model of the same provider. The cost cap still applies.
harness.toolsIntro: The master switch for web search in your runs. Each agent also needs its own switch in Create.
harness.webSearchLabel: Allow web search in my runs
harness.webContentLabel: Treat search results as data, not instructions
harness.webContentNote: Agents with web search are told that text from the web is untrusted. This is part of the fixed harness and cannot be turned off.
harness.fixed.webdata.label: Web content
harness.fixed.webdata.hint: Agents with web search are told that text from the web is data, not instructions, and a replay marks search results as untrusted.
editor.toolsNote: Give the web only to an agent that needs it. Everything an agent reads from the web is untrusted.
editor.searchOffInSettings: Web search is turned off in Settings, Harness, Tools. This agent will not search.
insp.untrusted: Untrusted web content: data, not instructions
harness.adjustableIntro: Kept in this browser only. It applies to new runs and to Retry. The server clips every value to its range, so you cannot go over the ceiling.
harness.limit.steps.label: Maximum steps
harness.limit.steps.hint: How many turns the agents may take in one run. 1 to 60.
harness.limit.tokens.label: Maximum tokens per run
harness.limit.tokens.hint: Input and output of all agents together. Up to 150,000.
harness.limit.searches.label: Maximum web searches
harness.limit.output.label: Maximum tokens of one reply
harness.limit.output.hint: Cuts a long reply of one agent short. 1,000 to 4,000.
harness.limit.timeout.label: How long to wait for the model
harness.limit.timeout.hint: A request is given up after this time. 30 to 120 s.
harness.profileIntro: One click sets the five limits below. Change any slider and the profile becomes Custom.
harness.profileDone: {name} profile set. Press Save to keep it.
harness.retriesIntro: What happens when the provider is busy or a call fails for a reason that may pass (429, 500, 502, 503, 529, a network error). Other errors, such as a wrong key, are never retried.
harness.limit.retries.label: Tries after a failure
harness.limit.retries.hint: 0 means a failed call stops the agent at once. 0 to 3.
harness.limit.retryDelay.label: Wait before each try
harness.retriesNote: Every try counts as a step, and the total time of 270 seconds still applies.
harness.costIntro: A run stops when its estimated cost passes this amount. Only agents on a paid key count; agents on a free Gemini key cost nothing. The estimate uses the prices in the catalog, so it can be a little off.
harness.limit.cost.label: Stop a run above
harness.costNote: Default: off. The cost is added up after each answer, so a run can go a little over before it stops.
harness.repeatIntro: Stops a run when the same agent gives the same answer again and again, which usually means it is stuck in a loop. Two answers count as the same when they match word for word, ignoring capital letters and spacing. It matters most for a supervisor and for debates.
harness.limit.repeat.label: Stop after the same answer
harness.limit.repeat.hint: Off, or 2 to 4 times in a row.
harness.repeatNote: Default: 3. A run stopped this way is saved, and the replay shows which agent repeated itself.
harness.handoffIntro: The most characters that one agent passes on to the next. A longer answer is cut and the next agent is told that it was cut. Your replay still shows the whole answer. This keeps long chains cheap.
harness.limit.handoff.label: Cut a handoff above
harness.handoffNote: Default: off. About 4 characters make one token, so 8,000 characters is roughly 2,000 tokens.
run.outcome.stopped_limit.repeat: The run stopped because an agent gave the same answer several times in a row. What happened so far is saved.

create.limitWarning.body: It needs about {turns} agent turns and {tokens} tokens, but your limits are {steps} steps and {maxTokens} tokens. The run would stop before the last agent. Remove an agent, or
create.limitWarning.link: change the limits in Settings, Harness.
run.outcome.stopped_limit.cost: The run stopped because its estimated cost reached your cost cap. What happened so far is saved.
harness.resetDone: Defaults restored. Press Save to keep them.
harness.fixedIntro: These cannot be changed, because safety, the hosting or a readable design depends on them.
harness.fixed.time.label: Total time of a run
harness.fixed.time.hint: The ceiling of the hosting. The run stops there.
harness.fixed.agents.label: Agents in a design
harness.fixed.agents.hint: More would not fit the time, the steps or the size of a request.
harness.fixed.task.label: Length of the task
harness.fixed.task.hint: Keeps a run readable and cheap.
harness.fixed.request.label: Size of a request
harness.fixed.request.hint: Larger when a run is carried on, because it brings the answers so far.
harness.fixed.pauses.label: Pauses of the model in one turn
harness.fixed.pauses.hint: Protects against waiting for a tool without end.
harness.fixed.rate.label: Runs per hour
harness.fixed.rate.hint: The server counts per address and stores nothing about you. The site operator can change it.
harness.fixed.keys.label: Keys
harness.fixed.keys.hint: They stay in the browser, locked with a passphrase if you choose. The server only passes them on and stores none.

create.title: Create a run
create.taskLabel: 1. Describe the task for the agents
create.patternHelp: The orchestration pattern decides how the agents work together: who works when and who sees what. It also decides which connections the diagram allows. Changing it clears the diagram.
create.pattern.sequential: One after another, each passes its result on.
create.pattern.parallel: Several work at the same time, one combines the results, and more agents may follow to review or polish.
create.pattern.supervisor: A supervisor hands out work and decides when it is done.
create.pattern.debate: Debaters argue in rounds, a judge decides.
create.patternChanged: The diagram was cleared because the orchestration pattern changed.
